metadata.description: 🗡️ Zweihander is a simple, robust, and versatile marketplace for agent plugins, forged for the chaos of the AI world.

plugins.name: langfuse
plugins.description: General-purpose Langfuse integration for data exploration, dashboard management, prompt versioning, datasets, and experiments.

plugins.name: openapi-tools
plugins.description: Skills for listing and inspecting OpenAPI endpoints on running services.

plugins.name: llm-application-dev
plugins.description: LLM application design, agent pattern selection, and schema-guided reasoning patterns.

plugins.name: giant-armor
plugins.description: Development, session and assistant-operations workflows in one plugin: git, PRs, tickets, releases, Python testing, run-and-verify, session tooling, Mermaid diagrams, and skill improvement.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Research workflows: arXiv paper search, grounded citations with a verifiable source ledger, an LLM-maintained Markdown wiki, and Obsidian vault notes.

plugins.name: web
plugins.description: Web, social, and feed reading workflows: Reddit, RSS/Atom feeds, blog tracking, YouTube transcripts, X via xurl, and blocked-page recovery.

plugins.name: os-tools
plugins.description: Operating-system utilities for local machine automation.

plugins.name: cloud-storage-tools
plugins.description: Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive, and MEGA style user-file storage tools.

plugins.name: job-hunt-toolkit
plugins.description: Version-controlled job application workspace with resume tailoring, Typst-to-PDF export, and pre-send checks.
